tabs.label: Commercial Cleaning
tabs.heading: Commercial Pressure Washing Services
tabs.subheading: Professional Exterior Cleaning for Businesses Across Raleigh & Surrounding Cities
tabs.body1: AAA Houston Pressure Washing, LLC provides comprehensive commercial exterior cleaning for businesses, property managers, and commercial property owners throughout Wake County, Durham County, Johnston County, and surrounding areas. From retail storefronts and office parks to parking lots, loading docks, and multi-story building exteriors, we have the equipment and expertise to handle any commercial cleaning challenge.
tabs.body2: We work around your business hours to minimize disruption, offer flexible scheduling including nights and weekends, and provide detailed commercial quotes with no hidden fees. Our fully insured team brings commercial-grade equipment and eco-friendly cleaning solutions to every job.

tabs.label: Driveway Cleaning
tabs.heading: Professional Driveway Cleaning in Raleigh & Surrounding Cities
tabs.subheading: Restore Your Driveway to Like-New Condition
tabs.body1: Your driveway is one of the first things visitors and neighbors notice about your home. Over time, concrete and asphalt driveways accumulate oil stains, tire marks, mold, mildew, and embedded dirt that regular hosing simply can't remove. Our professional driveway cleaning service uses commercial-grade pressure washing equipment to blast away years of buildup and restore your driveway to like-new condition.
tabs.body2: We use surface cleaners for even, streak-free results across the entire driveway surface — no zebra stripes or missed spots. Pre-treatment with eco-friendly degreasers breaks down oil and grease before we pressure wash, ensuring the deepest possible clean. Post-rinse and edge detailing complete the job.

tabs.label: Sidewalk Cleaning
tabs.heading: Sidewalk & Walkway Pressure Washing
tabs.subheading: Safe, Clean Walkways for Your Home or Business
tabs.body1: Sidewalks and walkways take a beating from foot traffic, weather, and organic growth. Algae, mold, and mildew make concrete surfaces dangerously slippery — especially after rain. Our sidewalk cleaning service removes all of it, leaving your walkways clean, safe, and looking their best.
tabs.body2: We clean front walkways, back paths, pool decks, and any other concrete or paver surfaces around your property. Our surface cleaner attachment ensures consistent pressure across the entire surface for streak-free results every time.

tabs.label: Front Patio Cleaning
tabs.heading: Front Patio & Entryway Pressure Washing
tabs.subheading: Make a Great First Impression Every Time
tabs.body1: Your front patio and entryway set the tone for your entire home. Dirty, stained, or algae-covered concrete sends the wrong message to guests and neighbors. Our front patio cleaning service restores your entryway to its original clean, welcoming appearance.
tabs.body2: We clean all front patio surfaces including concrete, brick, pavers, and natural stone. Stubborn stains from rust, leaves, and organic growth are pre-treated before pressure washing for the best possible results.

tabs.label: Back Patio Cleaning
tabs.heading: Back Patio & Outdoor Living Space Cleaning
tabs.body1: Back patios and outdoor living areas accumulate grime, mold, algae, and stains faster than almost any other surface on your property. Between cookouts, rain, and shade from trees, your back patio can go from beautiful to grimy in a single season. Our back patio cleaning service brings it back to life.
tabs.body2: We clean all back patio surfaces including concrete, pavers, brick, and composite decking surrounds. Pool deck cleaning, outdoor kitchen areas, and fire pit surrounds are all part of our comprehensive back patio service.

tabs.label: Window Washing
tabs.heading: Professional Window Washing Services
tabs.body1: Clean windows transform the look of your home and let in more natural light. Over time, windows accumulate hard water spots, pollen, dust, and oxidation that regular cleaning can't remove. Our professional window washing service leaves every pane spotless and streak-free.
tabs.body2: We clean all exterior windows using professional squeegee techniques and spot-free rinse water. Screen cleaning, sill wiping, and frame cleaning are included with every window washing service.

tabs.label: House Washing
tabs.heading: Professional House Washing in Raleigh & Surrounding Cities
tabs.subheading: Restore Your Home's Curb Appeal with a Deep Clean
tabs.body1: Your home's siding is constantly exposed to pollen, mold, mildew, algae, and environmental pollutants that dull its appearance and can cause long-term damage if left untreated. Our professional house washing service removes all of it safely and effectively, restoring your home's original color and curb appeal.
tabs.body2: We use a soft wash approach for all siding types — vinyl, hardie plank, brick, stucco, and wood — applying low-pressure water with professional-grade cleaning solutions that kill mold and algae at the root. This is safer than high-pressure washing and produces longer-lasting results.

tabs.label: Softwashing
tabs.heading: Professional Softwashing Services
tabs.subheading: Gentle on Surfaces, Tough on Mold & Algae
tabs.body1: Softwashing is the preferred method for cleaning delicate surfaces that can't withstand high-pressure washing — roofs, painted wood, stucco, EIFS, and older brick. Instead of relying on pressure alone, softwashing uses low-pressure water combined with professional-grade cleaning solutions to kill mold, algae, and bacteria at the root.
tabs.body2: Our softwash treatments are safe for all exterior surfaces and produce results that last 4–6 times longer than pressure washing alone because the cleaning agents kill the organic growth rather than just blasting it away.

tabs.label: Mold & Grime Removal
tabs.heading: Mold & Grime Removal Services
tabs.subheading: Eliminate Mold, Mildew & Organic Growth for Good
tabs.body1: Mold, mildew, and algae don't just look bad — they can cause structural damage to your home and pose health risks to your family. Our mold and grime removal service uses professional-grade biocides and cleaning solutions to kill organic growth at the root and prevent it from coming back.
tabs.body2: We treat all affected surfaces including siding, concrete, brick, wood, and roofing. Post-treatment preventive coatings are available to extend the time between cleanings and keep your property looking clean longer.

tabs.label: Fence Cleaning
tabs.heading: Professional Fence Cleaning Services
tabs.subheading: Restore Your Fence to Its Original Appearance
tabs.body1: Fences are constantly exposed to the elements and quickly accumulate mold, mildew, algae, dirt, and discoloration. Whether your fence is wood, vinyl, aluminum, or chain-link, our professional fence cleaning service removes years of buildup and restores it to its original appearance.
tabs.body2: We adjust our pressure and cleaning solutions based on your fence material to ensure a thorough clean without any damage. Wood fences receive a gentle soft wash to prevent grain raising, while vinyl and metal fences can handle higher pressure for a deeper clean.
